checkin: Hi! Thanks for booking with Southern Dawn Charters. Your order is Confirmed. If you have any questions, please feel free to give us a call. Additional Information Your boat will be located at St. Andrews Marina, 3151 W 10th St, Panama City, FL 32401 PLEASE ARRIVE 15-20 MINS PRIOR TO YOUR TRIP TO ENSURE THAT WE DEPART AT THE CORRECT TIME.
cancellation: Once reservations are made for your trip, it is final. If there are extenuating circumstances that the trip needs to be canceled by you, we will need a minimum of 5 days notice. If there is an issue with weather, we will contact you and let you know how we feel about fishing and give you the option to fish or reschedule, if there is no way to reschedule we can issue a refund at that time.
